source_title: 'Udta Teer' box office collection day 8: Ayushmann's film crosses Rs 50 cr worldwide
source_excerpt: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan's 'Udta Teer' has entered its second week with an improvement in its box office performance. The spy comedy has generated Rs 50.03 cr in worldwide gross collections after eight days of its theatrical release. The film's latest domestic earnings also registered a 26.7% increase, offering some relief after consecutive daily declines. With its worldwide collection touching the lower end of its reported budget range, the film is gradually approaching its estimated investment.According to Sacnilk, 'Udta Teer' earned Rs 2.85 cr net in India on Day 8, with screenings across 5,013 shows. Its cumulative domestic net collection has reached Rs 33.75 cr, while the India gross stands at Rs 40.28 cr. Overseas markets contributed Rs 75 lakh on Friday, taking the cumulative overseas gross to Rs 9.75 cr. The film was released in theatres on October 23, 2026.'Udta Teer' records a 26.7% rise in Day 8 collectionThe film registered a noticeable improvement on Friday after witnessing a decline in its daily earnings over the preceding three days. Its latest collection increased by 26.7% compared with Thursday's Rs 2.25 cr. The film had earned Rs 2.65 cr on Wednesday before dropping further the following day.'Udta Teer' began its theatrical run with Rs 4.10 cr net in India. Its collections subsequently increased to Rs 7.25 cr on Saturday and Rs 8.20 cr on Sunday. However, the first Monday brought a sharp decline, with earnings falling to Rs 3.20 cr. Tuesday recorded a marginal improvement with Rs 3.25 cr, followed by successive drops on Wednesday and Thursday.The opening week contributed Rs 30.90 cr to the domestic net total. Friday's performance has taken its second-week collection to Rs 2.85 cr so far.Ayushmann Khurrana's 'Udta Teer' approaches its estimated budgetAccording to NDTV, the film's estimated budget is between Rs 50 cr and Rs 65 cr. This reportedly includes production expenses, prints, advertising and cast salaries. With worldwide gross earnings reaching Rs 50.03 cr, the film has touched the lower end of its estimated budget range. However, gross collections do not represent the producers' actual recovery, as theatrical revenue is shared between exhibitors and distributors.The film's opening-day performance was also below Ayushmann Khurrana's biggest theatrical opener. 'Udta Teer' began with Rs 4.10 cr net in India, while his 2025 release 'Thamma' reportedly collected Rs 24 cr on its opening day. The difference highlights the relatively modest start of the latest release.'Udta Teer' day-wise box office collectionThe film's first three days provided its strongest contribution to the domestic total. Sunday emerged as its biggest single-day performer, while collections settled into a lower range during the weekdays.| Day | India net | India gross ||---|---:|---:|| Day 1 (Friday) | Rs 4.10 cr | Rs 4.83 cr || Day 2 (Saturday) | Rs 7.25 cr | Rs 8.70 cr || Day 3 (Sunday) | Rs 8.20 cr | Rs 9.84 cr || Day 4 (Monday) | Rs 3.20 cr | Rs 3.81 cr || Day 5 (Tuesday) | Rs 3.25 cr | Rs 3.85 cr || Day 6 (Wednesday) | Rs 2.65 cr | Rs 3.15 cr || Day 7 (Thursday) | Rs 2.25 cr | Rs 2.68 cr || Day 8 (Friday) | Rs 2.85 cr | Rs 3.42 cr || Total (8 days) | Rs 33.75 cr | Rs 40.28 cr |'Udta Teer' occupancy report and box office competitionThe Hindi 2D version recorded 15.33% overall occupancy on Friday. Morning shows registered 5.31%, while afternoon screenings recorded 10.38%. Evening occupancy improved to 15.85%, with night shows witnessing the highest turnout at 26.92%.The film had 6,265 shows on its opening day, recording 13% occupancy and approximately 1.88 lakh footfalls. Its average India net collection per show stood at Rs 6,544. The theatrical competition included Hindi releases 'Nayyi Navelli' and 'Prahaar', alongside Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2'.Directed by a spy-comedy premise, 'Udta Teer' features Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan in the lead roles.
